verified: MOVE anchors reference the four expected Topology connection IDs.
BOOK anchor references the structured Business external action.
Business public ABOUT and Services copy are structured outside the panorama.
Pannellum loadScene is owned by client/src/pannellum-adapter.js.
Application, InteractionExecutor, and TopologyResolver do not directly call loadScene or instantiate Pannellum.
MOVE resolves Topology first, then target Place/Space, then target Representation, then renderer transition.
semantic_path: MOVE anchor → Topology resolver → target Place/Space → Representation resolver → RendererAdapter.transitionRepresentation → Pannellum loadScene
claim_ceiling: This proves structural reconstruction in the committed reference implementation. It does not prove touch, motion, browser, iPhone, HTTPS, or end-user behavioral regression; those belong to Phase 5.
